title: EIDOS Connector Item Schema v1.0
description: Canonical product schema produced by mapFields() across all EIDOS CMS connectors (1C-Bitrix, WooCommerce, etc.)

id.description: Unique product identifier in the source CMS (e.g. IBLOCK_ELEMENT_ID or WC_Product ID)

title.description: Clean product title without HTML markup

description.description: Plain-text product description stripped of HTML tags and truncated to 5000 UTF-8 characters

category.description: Primary product category or section name

price.description: Numeric product price in store base currency

inStock.description: Whether the product has positive available quantity / is in stock

tags.description: Product tags, keywords, brand, or OEM part numbers

url.description: Relative or absolute URL to the product detail page in the CMS

imageUrl.description: Optional URL or path to the product preview image
